observation.command:
unset CATALINA_PID
# Stop all tomcats
for t in dienste anwendung api; do /opt/tomcat-$t/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; done
sleep 8
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 5
ps aux | grep -c "[c]atalina.base"
# Change ports: dienste 18080/18005, anwendung 18081/18006, api 18082/18007
sed -i 's/port="8080"/port="18080"/; s/port="8005"/port="18005"/' /opt/tomcat-dienste/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8081"/port="18081"/; s/port="8006"/port="18006"/' /opt/tomcat-anwendung/conf/server.xml
sed -i 's/port="8082"/port="18082"/; s/port="8007"/port="18007"/' /opt/tomcat-api/conf/server.xml
grep -oE 'port="18[0-9]+"' /opt/tomcat-dienste/conf/server.xml | head -3; grep -oE 'port="18[0-9]+"' /opt/tomcat-anwendung/conf/server.xml | head -3; grep -oE 'port="18[0-9]+"' /opt/tomcat-api/conf/server.xml | head -3
